params._emergencySigners: Array of initial emergency multisig signer addresses
params._governanceToken: Address of the governance token (0 for manual voting power)

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.title: Proposal title
params.values: Native currency values for each action

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MAX_ACTIONS().notice: Maximum number of actions per proposal

approvalThresholdBps().notice: Approval threshold: percentage of (for + against) that must be "for"         e.g., 5000 = majority (>50% of for+against)

emergencyExecute(address[],uint256[],byt.notice: Execute an emergency proposal immediately (no timelock) — requires 2/3 multisig

emergencyPause(uint256,bytes[]).notice: Pause all governance operations — requires 2/3 multisig

emergencyThreshold().notice: Required signatures for emergency action (must be > 2/3 of signers)

emergencyUnpause(uint256,bytes[]).notice: Unpause all governance operations — requires 2/3 multisig

getManualVotingPower(address).notice: Get manual voting power for an address

getProposalState(uint256).notice: Check current proposal state (combines status + time checks)

getTimelockForCategory(uint8).notice: Get timelock duration for a proposal category (public view)

getVote(uint256,address).notice: Get vote details for a voter on a proposal

getVotingPower(address).notice: Get the voting power of an address (public)

governanceToken().notice: Governance token address (voting power = token balance)

hasVoted(uint256,address).notice: Check if a voter has voted on a proposal

isEmergencySigner(address).notice: Whether an address is an emergency signer

proposalDeposit().notice: Minimum deposit to create a proposal (in governance token wei)

queueProposal(uint256).notice: Queue a successful proposal for execution (after timelock)

setApprovalThresholdBps(uint256).notice: Set the approval threshold (basis points of for+against that must be "for")
